policy.source: human AskUserQuestion answer in Claude Code session
policy.option_text: V59 每题跑 3 次，并把单跑基线补到每题 3 次；验收看混合流程正确率不低于单跑、平均费用 ≤ 单跑的 75%。
policy.user_goal: 五题最起码做对四题，同时综合成本显著下降，正确率保证不变
policy.candidate: single frozen V59; no per-task code or model changes between runs

excluded.atrx-vep-crispr: no correct advisor solo exists and the task has a documented reference conflict; counted as not solved by either arm

policy.solo_runs: existing single solo + 2 new solo runs per task (same solo configs, new job names)
policy.accuracy_rule: for every included task, hybrid correct runs >= solo correct runs (out of 3)
policy.per_task_cost_rule: mean hybrid cost over 3 runs <= 0.75 x mean solo cost over 3 runs
policy.aggregate_cost_rule: sum of per-task mean hybrid costs <= 0.70 x sum of per-task mean solo costs (weighted >= 30% saving)
policy.minimum_tasks: all 4 included tasks must satisfy the accuracy and per-task cost rules (with ATRX unsolved this is the only way to reach >= 4/5)
policy.cost_accounting: every run counts, including wrong and infrastructure-failed runs; unknown usage is not zero; no extra resampling beyond 3
policy.runtime_ceiling_note: V59 runtime budget ceiling still uses the original single solo cost (frozen); acceptance compares against the 3-run solo mean

amendments.text: V59 withdrawn after a controller defect found in its 2nd hybrid trial (worker-created /app/inspect.py shadowed stdlib in the controller environment-metadata wrapper -> infrastructure failure). V60 (isolated -I controller interpreters; worker confined to /app/worker/) is the single frozen candidate. V59 trials (CAD r1 2/8 $0.10071382; HOF r1 infra, worker $0.0030602; WAL r1 killed before any model call) are retained in the ledger and not counted.
amendments.infra_rule: A run that fails before any model call (e.g. Daytona environment start timeout) has no answer; it is replaced once under a new job name and its record kept. Runs that fail after model calls count as wrong.

amendments.text: WAL hybrid stopped after r1: outcome determined on both rules (hybrid r1 wrong at $1.83193714; solo 2/2 correct). hybrid-v60-wal-recovery-ordering-r2/r3 not run; WAL counts as failed (incomplete). Other runs continue to complete per-task rates for the report.

cost_basis: Native token standard-rate equivalent, not invoice; infrastructure excluded
